### Features

* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** New Unlock with choice. Pick HushGram PIN and a 4 to 8 digit PIN of your own unlocks your messages instead of your phone's lock. It stays on your phone and can't be recovered. Asked for in #134.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** New switch under Feed, Hide 'Are you interested' questions, off by default. It removes the bubble under a Home post that asks if you're interested, with no gap left and nothing answered for you. Asked for in #131.
* **Instagram - Show when someone was last active:** New patch with a switch under Messages, off by default. Active 5m ago under a name in your messages becomes the time itself, like Active at 3:42 PM. It uses the time Instagram already has, so nothing new is requested. Asked for in #132.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the Save button on reels, off by default. The Save button and its count leave the buttons beside a reel, and the rest close up. Posts in your feed keep theirs.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch under Downloads, Hold to download, off by default. Hold two fingers on a feed post or a reel for a second and it saves what's under them. Instagram's one-finger long press doesn't change.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** New switch under Settings entry, Open settings with a long press on your profile's menu, off by default. Holding the three lines on your own profile opens HushGram, and a tap still opens Instagram's menu. Asked for in #84.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch under Tab bar, Center the logo on Home's header, off by default. Instagram's logo sits in the middle of Home's top bar without the newer header's other changes. Asked for in #50.
* **Instagram - Rounded post corners:** New switch under Feed, Rounded corners on posts, off by default, with a small or large size. Photos, videos and carousels in Home and Following get rounded corners. Asked for in #135.
* **Instagram - Upload stories at full quality:** New patch that posts video stories at up to 1080 pixels wide and 9 Mbps instead of 720. Off by default, under Stories in HushGram settings. Asked for in #37.
* **Instagram - Hide paid partnership Reels:** New switch under Reels in HushGram settings, off by default, that keeps Paid partnership and boosted reels out of the Reels tab. Reels you open from search, a profile, Saved or a message still play. Asked for in #12.
* **Instagram - Accent color:** New patch that turns Instagram's blue into purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal after a restart. Off by default, under Layout in HushGram settings. Asked for in #8.
* **Instagram - HushGram launch screen:** New patch that shows HushGram's logo while Instagram starts on Android 13 and newer. Off by default, under Layout in HushGram settings. Asked for in #5.
* **Instagram - Find the reel you came from:** New patch. Tap a reel's author, open their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it. Off by default, under Reels in HushGram settings. Asked for in #30.
* **Instagram - Open developer options:** MetaConfig now lists flag names instead of numbers, and Developer has a Recommended flags page of named On or Off switches that needs Allow importing overrides. Asked for in #91, #25, #110, #50, #37 and #13.
* **Instagram - Install next to Instagram:** New patch that installs a second Instagram beside the first, with its own data and sign-in. It starts unselected in Manager. Asked for in #34, #61, #73 and #121.
* **Instagram - Save comment photo:** It now covers a comment's GIF too, saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, or as the animated WebP or MP4 when that's all Instagram has. Off by default, under Comments in HushGram settings. Asked for in #1.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** New patch that hides the status and navigation bars on Reels and Home, and a swipe from the edge brings them back. Both switches are off by default, under Reels and Feed. Asked for in #14.
* **Instagram - Long press to zoom:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default. Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big, and let go to close it. Asked for in #63.
* **Instagram - Start feed videos with sound:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default, that starts the first video on Home with its sound on. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Asked for in #103.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** Tab bar can now hide as you scroll, and has Tab bar opacity and Tab bar height lists. They're off or Standard by default, under Tab bar in HushGram settings, and a restart shows a change. Refs #87, #65.
* **Instagram - Back leaves Home:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default. Back on Home then leaves like Instagram does at the top of the feed, with no scroll up and no reload. Asked for in #54.
* **Instagram - Start Home on Following:** New switch under Feed, Instagram logo on Home, off by default. It needs Start Home on Following and puts Instagram's logo where the feed's name would be. Asked for in #126.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Tab bar has new switches to hide Search, Create or Profile, a Start tab list for where Instagram opens and a Tab order list. Everything starts off or at Instagram's order. Restart Instagram to see a change. Asked for in #20, #55 and #90.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Tab bar has four new Home header switches that hide Create or notifications, or add a Search or Ghost mode button. All start off, and a restart shows them. Asked for in #70 and #118.
* **Instagram - Start stories with sound:** New switch under Stories in HushGram settings, off by default, that opens a story with its sound on. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Asked for in #103.
* **Instagram - Control taps and volume on Reels:** New choice under Playback, A tap on a reel, that can pause or mute instead of Instagram's default. A switch below it keeps reels muted on the volume keys. Both start at Instagram's behavior.
* **Instagram - Blur the bars around Reels:** New switch under Reels in HushGram settings, off by default, that fills the bars around a reel that doesn't fill the screen with a blurred copy of it. Open Reels again after turning it on.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** New Hide posts you've liked switch and Hidden accounts list under Feed, off or empty by default. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one. Posts leave Home on the next refresh.
* **Instagram - Show hidden like counts:** New patch. Turn on Show like counts the poster hid, under Feed, and the like row shows the number whenever Instagram's server sent it. Off by default.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** The end of HushGram settings has a new row, Support HushGram, that opens my Ko-fi page. It also turns up if you search for coffee or Ko-fi.
* **Instagram - Profile posts as a list:** New patch, off by default, under Profiles in HushGram settings. Opening someone's profile takes you to their posts as a scrolling list, and Back shows the grid.
* **Instagram - Hide your active status:** New patch with a switch under Messages, off by default, so people you chat with don't see Active now for you. Restart Instagram. Ghost mode turns it on too.
* **Instagram - Hide Meta AI:** Three new switches, off by default: Hide the Muse button on your profile, Hide Blend on reels and Hide the Muse card on profiles.
* **Instagram - Default playback quality:** New row under Playback to pick the playback quality with a long press on a tab, from Auto to Highest. Off by default. Asked for in [#93](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/issues/93).
* **Instagram:** Press and hold New message at the top of your inbox to turn all the Ghost mode switches on or off together. A tap still starts a new message.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** New switch under Profiles, Put accounts that don't follow you back first, off by default. It puts them at the top of your Following list. Asked for in #40.
* **Instagram - Keep a seek bar on Reels:** New switch under Reels, Bigger seek bar on reels, off by default. It makes Instagram's seek bar thicker, with a round handle and the time above it. Asked for in #10.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** It can now hide single chats (Hidden chats) or lock them (Locked chats), under Messages in HushGram settings. Open a chat in Instagram first so it's on the list.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch, Download button on feed posts, off by default. It puts a download icon beside Save under each post and needs Download feed videos or photos. Asked for in #97, #116 and #117.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch, Show the Reels tab, off by default. It puts the tab back after Home when Instagram built your bar without it, and Hide wins if both are on. Asked for in #120.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the comment bar on all reels, off by default. The comment button still opens the comments. Asked for in #119.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the top bar on the Reels tab, off by default. The row with the Reels title and camera goes away and the reel stays put. Reels opened elsewhere keep their bar. Asked for in #14.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. It draws the tab bar as a floating pill of frosted glass with a highlight that slides to your tab. Off by default, under Tab bar, and a restart shows it. Refs #89, #65.
* **Instagram - Saved on your profile:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. It adds a bookmark to your profile's tabs that opens Saved. Turn it on under Profiles in HushGram settings and restart Instagram. Refs #89.
* **Instagram - Stop background wake-ups:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. Two switches under Battery, off by default, stop the alarms that wake your phone in the background. Notifications still arrive. Refs #89.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested stories:** New switch under Stories in HushGram settings, Hide the Music for you card, off by default. Asked for in #111.
* **Instagram - Hide Notes on profile pictures:** New patch with a switch under Profiles in HushGram settings, off by default, that takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, including the prompt to post one on your own. Notes in Messages stay.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - Open developer options:** Import flag names now applies on every Instagram 450 build. On four of them (the x86 and x86_64 builds and two others) it was left out, so MetaConfig kept showing numbers. Asked for in #91.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** Ticking or unticking a chat under Hidden chats now shows in your inbox as soon as you go back to it. Before, the inbox kept its old rows until you pulled to refresh or a new message came in.
* **Instagram - Hide ads:** Sponsored posts inside a page of posts, like Home's Older Posts page and Explore's chain of posts, are gone too, and so are rows of several ads between posts. Diagnostics counts both.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** Typing in the settings search box no longer freezes Instagram on a slow phone.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** A settings export that hits an error now says Couldn't export HushGram settings and lets you try again. Recommended flags does the same.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Home's For you feed no longer grows one post at a time when most of a page is suggestions. It asks for the next page sooner. Reported in #52.
* **Instagram - See who a story mentions:** The label now shows on stories in Instagram's older format, and tapping it opens the list without pausing or skipping the story. Refs #125.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order, instead of just the first. Reported in #78.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Hiding videos, photos, carousels, liked posts or accounts no longer shows the empty feed card while Home is still loading.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** The cover shows its whole title and the Unlock link again on a phone screen.
* **Instagram - Open developer options:** Export overrides no longer writes a file that Import overrides refuses. Reported in #67.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** The chip under a profile's counts grows with your phone's font size instead of cutting its words off. Reported in #24.
* **Instagram - Hide Meta AI:** With Hide Meta AI in search and Home's bar on, a keyword search's results no longer end in an Ask a follow-up bar.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Home no longer sits on gray loading boxes when your feed is all suggestions, like a new account that follows nobody. Asked about in #105 and #104.
* **Instagram - Keep in chat:** A view once or replayable photo or video you send now stays Instagram's own sent bubble instead of turning into an empty one. Refs #114.
* **Instagram - Pure black dark mode:** It now reaches the comments sheet, which stayed gray. Refs #108.
* **Instagram - Save profile picture:** Save profile picture and Copy username and bio now work in the newer pop-up list a profile's three dots open on some accounts. Asked for in #29.
* **Instagram:** HushGram does less background work. Full screen Reels and Home, Saved on your profile, Lock your messages and Find the reel you came from stop checking the screen when there's nothing to do. Reported in #129.
* **Tooling:** The release facts check reads the push gate's kept run again when the pre-push hook starts it in a fresh PowerShell.

### Improvements

* **Instagram:** The check that proves each hook landed in the right place now holds on all seven 450 builds, since it finds methods by what they load and call instead of names that change between builds.
* **Instagram:** HushGram settings open as a list of categories, and a tap opens one on its own page. A button under the status card switches to one long list. Thanks to @talhaeenss for #123. Asked for in #80 and #100.
* **Instagram:** HushGram settings look tidier. Each category's page starts with a line saying what it's for, and every row now has an icon. On the list of categories, the rows share one rounded card the way a section's rows do. Asked for in #130.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** The chip under a profile's counts has a color for each answer, blue, green or red, darker on a light profile. Thanks to @talhaeenss for #124.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** Download all now waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Download all on reels works the same. Asked for in #115.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Download cover now saves the largest picture a post carries, so a reel with a custom cover never saves its first frame instead.
* **Instagram:** When a patch fails on a type it didn't expect, the diagnostic report now names both types.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** The cover's Unlock link is darker on a light screen, easier to tap and readable to screen readers.
* **Instagram:** Several patches now look up what they need once instead of every time the screen redraws.
* **Instagram:** The diagnostic report counts each kind of card the stories row loads, so a card no switch covers yet, like the Music for you card in #111, shows up by name.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Hide shopping now also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products.
* **Tooling:** The patched APK check holds Hide the comment bar on all reels' guard in the right place, and the Clean up Reels tests cover all seven Instagram 450 builds.
* **Tooling:** The patch tests no longer need Instagram 449 or 439 in the fixture folder, and read 450's declared build instead.
* **Tooling:** The all-builds patch run takes only the builds of the Instagram version the catalog declares, and names older ones as skipped.
* **Tooling:** The release preflight finds tests a code-only commit left stale before any Gradle run does, in under a second.
* **Tooling:** Patch tests run by area, so Gradle can reuse results for areas whose inputs haven't changed.
* **Tooling:** Release notes come out in the shape Morphe Manager draws, as short scoped bullets under their type heading, and the release check holds every bullet to that. Asked for in #86.
* **Tooling:** The release checks that apply every patch as one Instagram leave out Install next to Instagram, and its own run checks that the result is a different package.
* **Tooling:** The release notes check now stops a bullet that runs over 40 words, not counting its closing credit, so Manager's card stays short. Asked for in #106.

### Validation

Validation: 4350 runtime tests passed locally. All 1732 patch tests passed too.

HushPinterest 0.0.7 has 27 patches for Pinterest 14.39.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. A patched Pinterest can now sign up for push notifications, which Google's Firebase used to refuse, and you can pick the folder your downloads go to. Hide ads also looks inside the rows of pins on Home and under a pin, and Hide shopping catches store product pins.

This release moves to Pinterest 14.39.0. Patch 14.39.0 and install it over your current HushPinterest with the same signing key, and your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- Pinterest 14.39.0 is now the supported version. All 27 patches apply to it, and 14.38.0 is no longer a target.
- New Fix push notifications patch, on by default. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up for push notifications when the request names Pinterest's original signature, and a patched Pinterest is signed with a different one, so it never got a notification token. The patch gives Firebase the original signature's fingerprint when Pinterest signs up and changes nothing else in the request. Its switch is on the new Notifications page under More settings.
- Download pins has a new Save in Pinterest's folder switch, and it starts off. With it on, downloads go to Pictures/100PINT/Pins, the folder Pinterest's own image saves use, instead of filling up Download. Board downloads, long-press downloads and retries from Download history follow it too, and the download messages and Download history point to that folder instead of Downloads. (#5)
- Download pins can also save into a folder you pick. Tap Pick a download folder and choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents in Android's folder picker. Android's Downloads still does the saving, so nothing gets copied and no storage permission is needed. Each download in Download history remembers its folder, so its messages point there even after you pick another. Tap the row again to pick a different folder or go back to Download. Save in Pinterest's folder wins while it's on, and picking a folder turns it off. (#5)
- Long-press download keeps Pinterest's own buttons again. Holding a pin in a grid showed only Download, because Pinterest's Pin, Share and More ideas buttons never sprang back in after the patch laid the menu out again. Now all three show with Download after them, and letting go on any of them does what it says.
- System share sheet opens Android's share menu from a pin's Share button on 14.39.0. The pin's id is now read from the fields Pinterest's share sheet fills, found when you patch, instead of by a name that pointed somewhere else in 14.39.0, which left Pinterest's own sheet showing with the switch on.
- Hide advertising ID now keeps Pinterest's browser ID out of Google's Block Store too. Pinterest kept it there so that, on a phone with Google backup on, it would outlast an uninstall and come back on a new phone, which let a fresh install send the old ID before you'd signed in. With the switch on, Pinterest finds no saved ID, and when it tries to save one it deletes the stored copy instead, so a reinstall starts fresh. The browser cookie for the install you're using keeps working the way it did.
- The settings home ends with a Support HushPinterest row. Tapping it opens the Ko-fi page in your browser, and if no app can open it you get a message with the address instead. Its text is translated into German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish.
- Download board no longer saves a board's pins a second time once they've dropped off Download history. The history still shows the newest 32 entries, and it now remembers the 500 before those. Removing a pin from Download history forgets its older downloads too.
- Morphe Manager and the patch index now show the HushPinterest icon next to the source instead of the owner's GitHub picture.
- Hide ads now looks inside modules. A row of ideas on Home or a group of pins under the pin you opened carries its own pins, and an ad in one got through because Hide ads only checked the row itself. Now the ad comes out of the row, and a row left with nothing in it goes too, heading and all. Hide AI-labeled pins and Hide shopping reach inside rows the same way. A pin that carries Pinterest's promotion or campaign ID also counts as an ad now. (#6)
- Hide shopping and product pins now hides a shop's product pins, the ones shown with a store name like Target or Nordstrom Rack and a tag icon under the picture. Pinterest doesn't mark them as paid, so Hide ads keeps leaving them alone, but they slipped past Hide shopping too. With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report also lists the shopping and ad fields of what stays, so a pin that still gets through can be tracked down. (#6)
- Hide ads now catches shopping spotlight stories on the feed models that keep the story kind as Pinterest's own type rather than as text. Before, only the text form counted, so a spotlight on those models stayed unless Hide shopping was on too. Other stories stay put, and Hide shopping still works on its own.
- If a Pinterest update leaves Hide ads only part of its hooks, the Feed page now names the feed lists and ad panels it couldn't reach instead of reading as if everything's covered. The diagnostic report lists every list and panel with how much of it went in, and names the two places no hook reaches yet (Shopping ideas groups in search results and shopping wrappers under related pins). A full build reads the same as before.
- Strip link tracking has a new Plain pin links switch on the Privacy page, and it starts off. With it on, a pin.it link you copy or share becomes the pin's own pinterest.com link, so it doesn't tell Pinterest who shared it. Links Pinterest makes for Copy link or a share change right away, even when you send a pin straight to another app, because HushPinterest sees which pin Pinterest made the link for. Any other short link you copy is checked with Pinterest in the background and swapped on the clipboard a moment later, as long as you haven't copied something else by then. Shared text never waits for that check, and if it fails or takes longer than 4 seconds the short link stays. A pin link from one of Pinterest's country sites, like de.pinterest.com or www.pinterest.co.uk, becomes the same www.pinterest.com link with no lookup, and a pin's sent link drops the invite code that ties it to whoever sent it. Board links and account pages stay as they are, and so does a pin link that still carries a parameter after tracking tags come off.
- HushPinterest settings has a new page under More settings, Pinterest's own settings. It shows where Pinterest keeps its own theme, privacy, notification, AI content and cellular autoplay settings, and names each step through Pinterest's menus in the language Pinterest is using. HushPinterest doesn't change any of them. The AI content row explains how it differs from Hide AI-labeled pins, and the autoplay row says Pinterest may still load part of a video ahead of time.
- HushPinterest drops its Android 9 code now that Pinterest 14.39.0 needs Android 10. The file picker saves go, along with their Pending saves page, and so does the app folder Android 9 used for diagnostic reports. Every download is handed to Android's Downloads, and a selection's summary no longer has a Saved line, since only the picker ever filled it.
- HushPinterest's short messages now show as Pinterest's own toasts. When a dialog is open, a message is long or has more than one line, or the Pinterest build's toast code isn't what the patch expects, they stay Android toasts.

## Behind the scenes

- The release receipt, the patch verifier and the device lease now hold the patched app to Android 10 (API 29), the same floor the settings patch sets since the Android 9 code went. They still expected API 28, so a target whose own floor was below 29 would have failed the receipt.
- While a release hold keeps the published index behind source, the release check now wants the bug report form to name the published release with the Pinterest build it was made for. It used to pair the published version with source's newer build, a combination nobody filing a report would have.
- The privacy doc now follows Pinterest's launch event, which carries the full URL the app was opened with, to both of its uploads: `v3/callback/event/` and `v3/callback/track_funnel/{event}/`. Disable analytics already stops both.
- The privacy doc now lists every header Pinterest puts on its API requests, with where each value comes from and whether a patch covers it. The advertising ID header is the only one a patch changes today.
- The header table now explains the last two. `X-Pinterest-AppState` only says whether the app is in front and online. `X-Pinterest-Platform-BID` is Pinterest's `_b` browser cookie, which the app keeps in Google Block Store (backed up to the cloud when Block Store offers end-to-end encryption), so it can survive a reinstall or a move to a new phone.
- The privacy doc now follows the install ID to all of its uses. Besides its own header it's Pinterest's signed-out ID, AppsFlyer's `unauth_id`, and the ID on analytics, push and reCAPTCHA events. A signed-in emulator kept its session, feed and search after the ID was swapped for a fresh one, so no hook is planned for it.
- System share sheet now checks, when you patch, that Pinterest gives a pin the share kind the patch makes pin links for. A build that numbers its kinds differently is refused instead of sharing a board's id as a pin link. The fixture tests cover that refusal and the two ways the sendable's constructor can stop naming its id and kind.
- Long-press download now checks that a menu button's detach handler really cancels the spring driver the patch clears, by finding the cancel call on that driver, not just a call that reads it. The fixture tests pin 14.39.0's spring fields and refuse a handler without the cancel.
- The patch verifier's System share and long-press checks now match the patch. The sendable's id and kind have to be its own fields written through itself, the springs reset needs a zero that isn't the button's register, and the spring driver has to be one the detach handler cancels.
- `scripts/test-app-inventory.ps1` checks the inventory tool on two tiny real APKs in `scripts/checks/inventory-fixture`, every section and the diff between them, in PowerShell 7 and 5.1. The script contract suite runs it, and `scripts/checks/build-inventory-fixtures.ps1` rebuilds the APKs from their Java sources.
- The Pinterest reference docs now describe 14.39.0. The APK facts, class and method names, endpoints and resource names were checked against the 14.39.0 build, with the old 14.38.0 name kept next to each one that moved. The patch reference covers all 27 patches. The signed-in screen survey and the runtime measurements are still the 14.38.0 runs, and the docs say so.
- The patch reference records the push sign-up check from a fresh emulator install. Without Fix push notifications, Firebase refused the sign-up with a 403. With it, the same install registered with Firebase.
- A fixture run that passes every check is now kept under a key made from the bundle, the APK, the patch selection and the hash of every verifier script, and a later run with the same key reuses it instead of patching Pinterest again. The release push gate patches each declared fixture once and the release receipt reads those runs. `scripts/patch-for-device.ps1` can sign the gate's patched APK for a phone when its key matches. A changed input means a full run, and a failed run is never kept.
- The push gate now runs the unit tests and lint in a quick Gradle pass before the fixture suite, so a broken test stops the push in minutes instead of after the Pinterest APK runs. Each pass waits for its own slot in the build queue.
- The script contract tests now parse every tracked PowerShell file, so a syntax slip in a script that only runs on a release or with a phone shows up on the next script push.
- Releases now run in stages from `scripts/release/release.ps1`: prepare, preflight, gate, build and publish. Each stage checks that the one before it finished, and running one again after it's done changes nothing. The CHANGELOG cut refuses any bullet that isn't a one-line Pinterest or Tooling entry and names it. The GitHub notes carry every bullet of the section. `publish-release.ps1` pushes the index commit as soon as the release is up and ends with `verify-published-index.ps1`. The notes and index text come from `release_text.py`, which has its own unit tests. (#3)
- `scripts/app-inventory.ps1` lists what a Pinterest build talks to and what it reads about the device. That covers its Retrofit endpoints with their verbs, the startup tasks, the hosts its code names, who opens connections, the SDK packages, and who reads the advertising ID, Android ID, install referrer or device identifiers. The lines come out sorted, with renamed packages written as `~`, so `-BaseApk` can diff two builds. The [privacy notes](docs/pinterest-14.39.0-privacy.md) now carry the 14.39.0 inventory and what changed from 14.38.0.

## Reported issues

Where each report on the tracker stands with this release.

- #6, ads getting through (@darenrue). Hide ads now checks inside the rows of pins on Home and under a pin you open, where an ad could slip past before. The store cards with a shop name and a tag icon, like the Target one in the report, aren't paid ads, so Hide ads leaves them. `Hide shopping and product pins` now hides them, and it starts off, so turn it on under Feed. The issue stays open until it's confirmed on your phone.
- #5, save downloads to a folder you choose (@boox3). New here. `Pick a download folder` under Pin actions saves pins straight into any folder in Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. `Save in Pinterest's folder` puts them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves.
- #4, one patch source for every Hush app (@Stark-0505). Still open. HushPinterest is still its own source in this release.
- #3, matching the Morphe template's release setup (@Stark-0505). Partly in. The patch index now goes up in the same step as the release, so Morphe Manager offers the update as soon as it's out, and a check after every release confirms the index matches. Moving to the template's own release workflow is still open.
- #2, Download pin said Pinterest had no original image (@Stark-0505). Fixed in 0.0.5. Download pin gets the original image behind the size Pinterest shows.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.39.0**, version code **14398020**, as the universal APK, and patch it. It needs Android 10 or newer.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.39.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 204 patch tests and 702 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.39.0 APK with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 27 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.7.json` records that result, the APK's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest. Pick a download folder, the store pin filter and the module filter for Hide ads were also checked on a phone running this build's patches.

You can translate a whole chat, keep a copy of downloaded files and songs in your phone's Download folder, make folders by chat type in one tap, and get notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. * **Telegram:** New Hide Contacts tab switch on the Chat list page. And when someone else replies to a blocked person, their reply now shows without the quote of what was said, the way a reply to a deleted message looks.
* **Telegram:** A wording pass. Pause is explained the same way everywhere, Import settings says what a file holds, and errors that left you guessing now say what to do next: download a damaged file again, update HushTelegram for a file from a newer one, or open an export that couldn't be checked.
* **Telegram:** With Debug logging on, what HushTelegram writes to Android's log goes through the same redaction as an exported report, so tokens and keys in a message or an error stay out of it.
* **Telegram:** The App name option turns down direction marks and zero-width characters, which could flip or hide the name under the icon. Emoji built with zero-width joiners still work, and so do Persian, Kurdish and Indic names that need the zero-width non-joiner.
* **Telegram:** Export diagnostic report says "Preparing the diagnostic report" while it builds the report and takes no second tap until the copy or the file is done. The back arrow and the name at the top use the page's own white, and the back arrow shows when a keyboard is on it.
* **Telegram:** A keyboard or D-pad gets into the list as soon as settings opens, stops on the status card and on the paused page's status line, where Enter presses their Pause, Resume or Undo button, and a ring shows which row it's on. The two Export diagnostic report choices read as buttons to a screen reader, and a ring marks the one a keyboard is on.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram's own dialogs in a chat (Message details, Forward to, the Ask before questions) now go light or dark with Telegram's theme. Before, they followed the phone's dark mode, so they could come out white over Telegram's Night theme.
* **Telegram:** Import settings now lists every switch the file changes and which way it goes, like "Hide ads turns off", under the count. A file someone shared with you can't quietly turn off Stop usage reports anymore.
* **Telegram:** When Telegram turns down the API ID your build signs in with, the phone number screen now says so, with a button that opens the guide to using your own ID. Before, it just sat there after you tapped the arrow. This covers API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, the built-in ID being refused, and API_ID_INVALID, a registered ID or hash with a typo in it. Reported in #11 and #3.
* **Telegram:** Keep deleted messages remembers the newest 5,000 kept messages per account. Past that, the oldest ones now go to Telegram's own deletion, the way they would have without the switch. Before, they stayed in the chat without their deleted label, where Clear kept messages couldn't reach them. If Telegram can't take some of them back, they stay kept and are first in line next time, so newer kept messages aren't pushed out early. Clear kept messages also can't hand the same message over twice when another one is kept at that moment, so its count stays right.
* **Telegram:** Messages that pop up at the bottom of the screen are shorter now, so Android shows them whole instead of cutting them off after two lines.
* **Telegram:** The Export settings row now says what a file carries (your switches, filter lists and sticker size) and which switches stay out of it.
* **Telegram:** A new Folders by chat type switch on the Chat list page, off by default, makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. Private takes in your contacts and everyone else. A type you already have a folder for is skipped, and Telegram's folder limit is kept, with a toast that says when it left no room. Turning the switch off removes the folders it made. One you've renamed, given an emoji, or added, left out or pinned chats in is yours and stays. A color doesn't count, since Telegram gives each new folder one of its own. If nothing can be done (HushTelegram is paused, you're signed out, or Telegram is still loading your folders) the switch goes back and a toast says why. The switch isn't in settings backups, since importing it wouldn't make or remove anything. Asked for in #7.
* **Telegram:** A new Save downloaded files switch on the Playback page, off by default, puts a copy of each file and song you download in Download/Telegram on your phone, the folder Telegram's own Save to Downloads uses. File managers, music players and other apps can open them there. It covers documents and songs. Photos and videos already have Telegram's Save to gallery settings, and GIFs, voice messages and round videos stay in Telegram. So does anything from a secret chat, self-destructing media, and chats or messages that don't allow saving. A file that's already there with the same name and size isn't copied twice. A name with hidden text-direction marks in it, or one too long for the file system, is cleaned up so the copy still lands. On Android 9, and on Android 10 when Telegram has storage access, Telegram's own folder is already open to other apps, so nothing is copied. Asked for in #7.
* **Telegram:** A new UnifiedPush notifications switch on the Notifications page, off by default, is for phones where Firebase notifications don't come through. Install a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, turn the switch on, and Telegram signs up the address that app gives it, through the Simple push type Telegram's own API has for this. Telegram's servers call that address when something arrives, the app wakes Telegram, and Telegram fetches the message itself, so only the wake-up passes through the UnifiedPush app. The Push app row under the switch shows how the sign-up is going, and reads it again when you come back to Telegram, so a sign-up the app ended while you were away shows as ended. The sign-up reaches ntfy even if you haven't opened it since installing it. With more than one UnifiedPush app installed and no ntfy among them, you pick which one gets the sign-up. Turning it off ends the sign-up and has Telegram ask Firebase again right away. Uninstalling the UnifiedPush app does the same at the next start. The switch isn't in settings backups, so a file someone shared can't route your wake-ups through another app. Asked for in #5.
* **Telegram:** Translate with an outside service can now use an AI service with your own key instead of Google's web translate. Tap Translation service under the switch and fill in the address, model and key. Anything that takes OpenAI's chat format works, like OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq or Gemini's OpenAI address. The key stays on your phone: it isn't in settings backups, the diagnostic report or the log, and it only goes over https (plain http is allowed just for a model server on the phone itself). A message already in your language stays as it is, and if the service turns your key down you'll get a toast that says so. A redirect from the service isn't followed, so the text and the key only ever go to the address you typed. Use Google in the same dialog goes back and forgets the key. Asked for in #2.
* **Telegram:** A new Faster downloads switch on the Playback page, off by default, has files download in 512 KB pieces with 8 requests at a time instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. That's the setting Telegram already uses for accounts its servers pick for it, so it isn't a Premium unlock, and the servers still decide how fast they send. If a big piece fails, Telegram drops back to small ones on its own like before. It applies from the next download, no restart needed. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** A new HushTelegram icon and name patch puts HushTelegram's own badge on your home screen, with a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. Its one option changes the name under the icon. It isn't selected by default, since there's no switch to undo it after patching: turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick it. An alternate icon you chose in Telegram's own settings keeps its look. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** AMOLED black now turns the launch screen black too, on Android 13 and up while your phone is in dark mode, so Telegram no longer opens on its dark blue screen before the black one. It's Android's own black screen with Telegram's icon on it, so nothing is added to Telegram's resources. Turning AMOLED black off or pausing HushTelegram brings Telegram's own back the next time it starts. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** A new Translate with an outside service switch, off by default, adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. The text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. Turning the switch off forgets the chats and messages you'd turned on, so switching it back on later sends nothing until you choose again. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks aren't touched.
* **Telegram:** Two new switches on the Look and feel page, both off by default. Hide channel bar buttons takes Search, Direct messages and Info out of the bar at the bottom of a channel and leaves Mute and Join. Gift already goes with Hide Premium, gifts and Stars, and a channel's Recent actions log keeps its own Search. Hide Send as button hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, but only while you're posting as yourself, so you'll always see it when a message would go out under a channel's name.
* **Telegram:** A new Hide messages by keyword switch on the Conversations page, off by default, with a list of filters for groups and another for channels. A filter is one line: plain text matches wherever it appears in a message, and a line in slashes like /crypto|airdrop/ is a regular expression. Neither minds capital letters. Matching messages are left out of a chat when you open it, the way Telegram leaves out a message it can't show, so nothing is deleted and the server never hears about it. Private chats and your own messages are never filtered. The editor refuses a line it can't use and says which one, including an expression that could take too long on a long message, and it won't keep a list too big to carry in a settings file. Settings export carries both lists, and an older HushTelegram leaves them out of an import rather than refusing the file.
* **Telegram:** Hide Premium, gifts and Stars now also covers Premium stickers if you don't have Premium. They're left out of sticker packs, the sticker keyboard and its favorites and recents, the way Telegram leaves them out where Premium can't be sold, and a Premium sticker someone sends you no longer plays its full-screen effect or pops up the Premium tooltip. The sticker itself still shows in the chat. The emoji keyboard drops locked emoji packs too, so the emoji tab only lists emoji you can send, and a Premium pack with some free emoji keeps those. With Premium, nothing changes.
* **Telegram:** A new Change sticker size switch on the Look and feel page, off by default, with a Sticker size row under it. Pick 50%, 75%, 125% or 150% of the size Telegram gives a sticker in a chat, and a chat shows the new size the next time you open it. Animated emoji and dice keep their own size. Settings export carries the size you picked, and an import refuses a size that isn't one of the four.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram settings no longer puts about 55 switches on one Chats page. They're now on Ads, Chat list, Conversations, Playback, Notifications, Look and feel and Privacy, the same groups Morphe Manager sorts the patches into, and each patch's description names its page. Hide phone number and Turn off beta debug logs moved to Privacy. Your saved choices don't change, and search still finds every switch.
* **Telegram:** The two longest settings pages, Conversations and Look and feel, are now split under short headings like Translation or Theme, each group in a card of its own, so a switch is easier to find than in one long list of thirty. Switch rows also dropped the icon they all repeated, which gives their text the full width. Asked for in #6.
* **Telegram:** Telegram 13.0.1 is now the supported version, both telegram.org's build (version code 71679) and the official beta (71669). Every patch is checked against those two builds, and 12.10.6 and 12.10.7 are no longer supported.
* **Telegram:** Several patches were updated for the way Telegram 13.0 builds its screens, so they keep working there: Hide Stories, Hide Premium, gifts and Stars, Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends, Gallery camera on tap, Quiet contacts nag, Holiday look all year, and the HushTelegram row in Telegram's own settings.
* **Telegram:** Telegram 13.0 renamed My TON in Settings to Gram Earnings. Hide Premium, gifts and Stars still hides that row under its new name.
* **Telegram:** Telegram 13.0 no longer sends the storage report that Disable analytics used to stop, so the patch doesn't look for it anymore. Channel read times and Premium screen reports still stay on your phone.
* **Telegram:** Hide Premium, gifts and Stars now also hides the Wallet row that Telegram 13.0 added to Settings. Settings then looks the way it does for an account that has no Wallet.
* **Telegram:** Hide Premium, gifts and Stars now also takes the Wallet button out of the chat list menu and the attach menu. The other attach buttons, Gallery and File included, stay just as Telegram lays them out without Wallet, and the chat list menu keeps everything else it shows, mini apps too.
* **Telegram:** Hide Premium, gifts and Stars now also hides Send Gram in the three other places Telegram 13.0 offers it: a profile's menu, the menu that opens when you tap a TON address, and the menu on a Gram transfer message. Each one then looks the way it does for an account without Wallet. Copy address and View in explorer stay on TON addresses, and Gram transfers people send you aren't touched.
* **Telegram:** Use system font now covers Wallet too. Card numbers and amounts switch to your phone's monospace font at the weight Wallet asks for, so the columns still line up. The small font that draws the Gram currency sign stays as it is, since phone fonts don't have that sign.
* **Telegram:** Disable analytics now stops the camera's dual camera report, which tells Telegram your phone's maker and model when its servers ask for device stats. The camera itself works as before.
* **Telegram:** The settings home page ends with Support HushTelegram, which opens the Ko-fi page in your browser.
* **Telegram:** The settings status card no longer shows a stale "HushTelegram X is made for Telegram Y" line when you're already running a build newer than the last release it knew about. It stays quiet until it finds a release newer than yours.

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** The source ledger is caught up with the October 11 audit (new sources, moved pins, 397 forks), and the census is fresh again. Sources hosted somewhere other than GitHub or GitLab now get their own list with the version an index last showed, so the audit stops flagging one it can't read and speaks up again when a new version appears.
* **Tooling:** The settings screen's code is split into one method per page, and patch helpers nothing called anymore are gone. The release script keeps gh's warnings out of what it publishes, and the release receipt stops on a clone git can't open instead of reading it as a copy with no history.
* **Tooling:** The selection matrix expects the Firebase crash and session report switches only on a build that ships those SDKs, which is Telegram Beta. It also rebuilds the one call Turn off beta debug logs adds to Telegram's startup settings the way the patcher adds it, so a default build no longer fails there, while a call in the wrong place, on the wrong register or added twice still does. With HushTelegram icon and name in the selection, it expects the app and Telegram's default launcher entry to point at the icon that patch adds, and nothing else in the manifest to change.
* **Tooling:** The selection matrix no longer fails every selection that includes Save downloaded files. That patch has the patcher rewrite one of Telegram's classes, which drops two values set to zero and false, and a field left without a value starts at zero or false anyway. The check now reads those as the same, and a real value that goes missing still fails it.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reads the Morphe Patch Tracker again. The tracker now names some bundles twice in different case, like `ImmortalZeus:dev` and `immortalzeus:dev`, and PowerShell couldn't hold both, so the whole source failed. Files like that are now read with case kept, and both bundles count.
* **Tooling:** The source audit reads Jman's bundle index again. It moved to `Jman-Github/Patch-Bundle-Registry`, and the bundle list and patch catalog the audit used to read are gone. The audit now reads the registry's own snapshot: the newest generation, every latest bundle that targets Telegram, and the Telegram patches in each. The ledger points at the registry and at HushTelegram's listing there.
* **Tooling:** Awesome Morphe lists HushTelegram now, so the ledger records the listing and the release check stops calling it pending.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram 13.0.1, version code 71679, from telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android). The official beta 13.0.1, build 71669, works too. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.12? That one was built for 12.10.6, so patch the new 13.0.1 APK and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram won't send you a login code, register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Use only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the new UnifiedPush notifications switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

959 runtime tests and 419 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints. All 68 patches applied without forcing to Telegram 13.0.1 (version code 71679) and to the 13.0.1 beta, build 71669. The release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries, resources and alignment.
